lines.text: Hi, I will get to Maple Station at two. Where should we meet?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Meet me at the east door. The west door is closed, and the east door is by the taxi stop.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Got it, the east door. Can we buy a small gift for my host before we go?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Sure. There is a tea shop near the station. How much do you want to spend?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: About twelve dollars. I saw a nice tin of tea on the shop's website yesterday.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: The tin costs sixteen dollars, but a small box of tea is ten. The shop closes at three.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: I will get the small box then. We can walk straight to the shop after we meet.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Good idea. Two at the east door, then we go to the tea shop.
lines.speaker: Eli
